name: Dolt
summary: A MySQL-compatible SQL database with Git-style version control: fork, clone, branch, merge, push and pull tables.
use_cases: import CSV files into a versioned database
store agent memory for multi-agent workflows
features: branch, merge, push and pull databases
version control via SQL system tables and procedures
diff tables between commits or branches

capabilities.label: Version control a SQL database like Git
Import CSV files from the command line
Diff tables between branches or commits
Query historical data with AS OF
Undo changes and restore dropped databases
Show who last modified each row
Export all tables to a file
Rewrite commit history with a query
Support foreign keys, triggers, stored procedures

setup.command:
dolt config --global --add user.email sbx@example.com && dolt config --global --add user.name "Sbx Tester" && cat > /tmp/f1.sh <<'EOF'
set -e
rm -rf /tmp/f1 && mkdir -p /tmp/f1/db /tmp/f1/remote && cd /tmp/f1/db
dolt init
dolt sql -q "create table t (id int primary key, name varchar(20)); insert into t values (1,'alice');"
dolt add . && dolt commit -m "first"
dolt checkout -b feature
dolt sql -q "insert into t values (2,'bob');"
dolt commit -am "add bob"
dolt checkout main
dolt merge feature
dolt remote add origin file:///tmp/f1/remote
dolt push origin main
cd /tmp/f1 && dolt clone file:///tmp/f1/remote cloned && cd cloned
dolt sql -q "select * from t order by id"
cd /tmp/f1/db && dolt sql -q "insert into t values (3,'carol');" && dolt commit -am "add carol" && dolt push origin main
cd /tmp/f1/cloned && dolt pull origin main && dolt sql -q "select * from t order by id"
dolt log --oneline
EOF
cat > /tmp/f34.sh <<'EOF'
set -e
rm -rf /tmp/f34 && mkdir -p /tmp/f34 && cd /tmp/f34 && dolt init >/dev/null
dolt sql -q "create table emp (id int primary key, name varchar(20)); insert into emp values (1,'tim'); call dolt_add('-A'); call dolt_commit('-m','init emp'); call dolt_checkout('-b','br'); update emp set name='timothy' where id=1; insert into emp values (2,'aaron'); call dolt_commit('-am','edit on br'); call dolt_checkout('main');"
dolt sql -q "select message from dolt_log order by date"
dolt sql -q "select name from dolt_branches order by name"
EOF

smoke_tests.command: cd /tmp && dolt --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3306 --no-tls -u root -p "" sql -q "create database getting_started; use getting_started; create table teams (id int primary key, team_name varchar(20)); insert into teams values (0,'Engineering'); select * from teams; select @@version_comment"

pitfalls.actually_needed: Without root, download dolt-linux-amd64.tar.gz from releases/latest and copy bin/dolt to ~/.local/bin (the README mentions this as its no-root fallback)

pitfalls.readme_said: Configure user.email and user.name before committing
pitfalls.actually_needed: dolt config --global --add user.email/user.name were needed before dolt commit (done in setup command 3)

pitfalls.readme_said: dolt -u root -p "" sql connects to the running server
pitfalls.actually_needed: Used dolt --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3306 --no-tls -u root -p "" sql -q ... against the server, run from a directory that is not a dolt repo

judge.observed: All three checks exit 0 and show their expected signals: the cloned table includes row 3 carol after push/pull, the SQL checkout returns "Switched to branch 'br'", and dolt version prints 2.7.5 (with only a harmless offline update-check warning).

Unbounded read from invalid inputs in encoding/binary

what_it_does.quote:
Dolt is a SQL database that you can fork, clone, branch, merge, push
and pull just like a Git repository.

who_it_is_for.quote:
It's the best database 
for agent memory, especially as you move up the ladder to multi-agent and 
multi-machine workflows.

prerequisites.quote: Make sure you have Go installed, and that `go` is in your path. Dolt has a dependency on [cgo](https://pkg.go.dev/cmd/cgo), so you will need a working C compiler and toolchain as well.

first_run_example.quote:
dolt sql-server
Starting server with Config HP="localhost:3306"|T="28800000"|R="false"|L="info"

config_and_keys.quote:
$ dolt config --global --add user.email YOU@DOMAIN.COM
$ dolt config --global --add user.name "YOUR NAME"

troubleshooting_uninstall.quote: The 9.0 release changes authentication support and isn't able to connect to a Dolt SQL server by default.
